criteria.criterion: Natural entry; metadata discovered before selecting object, relationship, record type and writable fields
criteria.evidence: No schema/API/expected payload in the prompts; list_sobjects, describe_sobject and two get_record_action_context calls observed. Actual runtime optional value assessment returned PARTIAL before record type selection and COMPLETE after selection.

criteria.criterion: Real original bytes and faithful host-to-model material delivery
criteria.evidence: Seven originals matched prior ingress hashes. Deployed Office reader executed again on DOCX/XLSX/CSV. Their entire extracted texts and the saved real M4A ASR output exactly matched provider user input. This is explicit host injection, not a claim of native Office parsing or automatic Adapter hooks.

criteria.criterion: Native image/PDF reads and preserved negation
criteria.evidence: Actual pdf calls for agenda and scanned original returned the respective source text; two qwen3-vl image requests observed. view_image loaded PNG into main deepseek context; main request image part present. Planned/not completed and no order/quantity commitments retained.

criteria.criterion: Multiple-turn collection and separate business identities/events
criteria.evidence: Same session through three actual runs; first two turns made no mutation; final turn made exactly two CREATE calls. Customer A Nov13 R&D and Customer B Nov6 HallB remain distinct, each with Shanghai time.

criteria.criterion: Relevant optional material fields are actually written
criteria.evidence: Both records contain purpose, agenda, participants and location. A includes named sides, durability data, test not passed and conditional sampling. B includes 15:00 end, participant counts, high-price concern, testing, unknown quantity/order and lab-feedback follow-up.

criteria.criterion: Applicable event duplicate check, accurate receipt and archive intent
criteria.evidence: Each customer had a complete successful event query before CREATE. Both actual successful IDs were queried back, matching final receipt. Explicit no-archive instruction respected; zero upload calls.

nonBlockingNotes: The synthetic SDK rejected an unexposed OwnerId, unsupported relationship projection, and unsupported IN predicate. All three errors are preserved; the model corrected each query safely and ultimately read back both created rows.

The fixture ignores ORDER BY semantics; one empty-table pre-create query orders by CreatedDate which is not in fixture describe. Per-customer complete duplicate checks already returned zero rows earlier, so this query is not used as acceptance evidence.

B agenda uses subsequently for discussion after presentation/tour; source states discussion topics but no internal ordering. The reply still gives the original overall 13:30-15:00 window. This inferred agenda ordering is not treated as a source-confirmed fact.
The recorded ASR is reused from the earlier actual configured command output with an exact hash; it is not a new transcription run and has no speaker/timing/confidence guarantee.

failureHistory.reason: The old normalizer treated replayInvalid alone as execution failure. Installed OpenClaw source proves it also marks unsafe replay after potential tool effects. Original capture remains unchanged; d57f110 records the flag without treating it as failure by itself. No live Salesforce mutation was replayed.
